title: Lead - Security Architecture
description:
**About Northern Trust**

  

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.  



  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.  



  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.  



  

  

Security Architect role is accountable for driving security initiatives for the organization. Under limited supervisions, you will work with a wide variety of business stakeholders and IT professionals (including different Security functions, Enterprise Architecture, Technology Infrastructure, and Cloud Engineering teams) to ensure organizational security needs/controls are aligned to support business goals and objectives.

  

* Define security functional requirements and non\-functional requirements to meet the business objectives of a solution
* Work with stakeholders in setting the technical direction, selection, and evaluating candidate security solutions
* Work with stakeholders to design and document the conceptual and detailed designs of security solutions
* Lead the development of security standards, reference architectures, patterns, and guidelines
* Assess effectiveness of security controls i.e. data protection, IAM, detective controls, infrastructure/network security, incident response. Work on
* identifying and driving implementation of appropriate controls, processes, and remediation of non\-compliance
* Research and advocate new technologies, architectures, and security products that will support security maturity roadmap
* Act as a subject matter expert for advisory, review and approval of security designs, configurations, baselines, and technical standards
* Create and review threat models using various approaches such as off the shelf tools, whiteboarding etc.
* Good to have hands on Microsoft Threat Model and SD Element or any other open source threat modelling tools
* Interfaces frequently with information security industry groups to stay abreast of emerging security trends
* Helps establish overall enterprise information security architecture (EISA) by aligning business processes, IT software and hardware, local and wide area networks, people, operations, and projects with the organization’s overall security strategy
* Evaluates proposals to determine if proposed security solutions effectively address enterprise requirements, as detailed in solicitation documents
* Interprets and/or approves security requirements relative to the capabilities of new information technologies.
* Good understanding of AI and emerging technologies. Which includes GAI, Deep Learning, Guardrails, etc..

 **Work Experience / Knowledge**:

  

* 10\+ years’ IT experience with 6\+ years focused on security and solution architecture
* 3\+ years’ experience with cloud delivery platforms IaaS/PaaS/SaaS and providers such as Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Microsoft
* Experience leading enterprise\-wide security initiatives, including architecture and implementation of various security solutions \& processes
* Ability to engage with senior leaders to define requirements and communicate effectively the results and risks
* Expert in 1 or more technology domains – infrastructure, application, network, IAM, data, endpoint
* Experience working with enterprise architecture practice and methodology, with security focus.
* Experience authoring security standards, reference architectures, patterns, and guidelines
* Knowledge of or experience with industry security controls frameworks such as NIST, CSA CCM, CIS Critical Security Controls.
* Hands\-on experience in Cloud (Microsoft Azure/GCP/AWS ) security architecture, security engineering, or equivalent experience with vendor specific cloud certification.

 **Qualifications:**

* BE/Btech degree and relevant work experience is required
* 8\-10 years of experience in software development, information security and architecture design \& controls
* Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) or equivalent
* Preferred \- certified in an enterprise architecture methodology and framework like TOGAF or SABSA
* Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Certified Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK), or preferred vendor certifications from AWS, Microsoft Azure or Google Cloud Platform
* In\-depth knowledge and understanding of OWASP Top 10 and CWE Top 25 with experience in assessment and providing remediation strategies

 **Working with Us**

  

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.  



  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.  



  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

  

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.  

  



  

**About Our Pune Office**

  

The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.

  

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000\+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

title: Assistant Director of Human Resources
description:
**Additional Information**  

**Job Number**26122494  

**Job Category**Human Resources  

**Location**Golf Course Square, Airport Road, Yerwada, Pune Mahar 411006, India  

**Schedule**Full Time  

**Located Remotely?**N  

**Position Type** Management  

**JOB SUMMARY**


Assists the Director of Human Resources in executing strategies that serve to attract, retain, and develop diverse premiere talent. Position directs and works with human resource employees to carry out the daily activities of the Human Resource Department, including recruitment, total compensation, employee relations, and training and development. Executes against objectives outlined in the Human Resources Business Plan and delivers services that meet or exceed the needs of employees and enable business success. Ensures compliance with applicable regulations and Standard Operating Procedures.


**CANDIDATE PROFILE**

**Education and Experience**


* High school diploma or GED; 4 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


OR


* 2\-year degree from an accredited university in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related major; 2 years experience in the human resources, management operations, or related professional area.


**CORE WORK ACTIVITIES**


**Managing the Staffing and Recruiting Process**


* Ensures open positions are advertised in appropriate venues to attract a diverse candidate pool.


* Ensures the open position listing is in a visible location for both internal and external candidates.


* Works with Employment Administrator to establish and maintain contact with external recruitment sources (e.g., state job service, local colleges, recruiting agencies, and community based organizations).


* Networks with local organization and peers to source candidates for current or future openings (e.g., Hotel Association).


* Facilitates interdepartmental transfers and promotions and transfers or promotions to other properties within this property brand.


* Oversees the selection and offer processes for hourly employees to ensure proper procedures are followed (e.g., valid reasons for selection/non\-selection are documented, applicants receive status notifications).


* Partners with department managers and recruiting professionals to recruit management positions, make hiring decisions and negotiate job offers in accordance with SOPs.


**Managing Legal and Compliance Practices**


* Ensures compliance with key policies (e.g., Sexual Harassment, Non\-Harassment, Non\-Discrimination, No Solicitation).


* Ensures interviews are conducted according to recommended guidelines, consistent screening criteria is used, and only job\-related questions are asked.


* Ensures wages are paid in accordance with Standard Operating Procedures and federal and state laws (e.g., employee pay for meeting attendance, wages limited to maximum rate of pay, entry level rates paid to new hires, overtime provisions in place, separation pay).


* Ensures drug screening and background checks are completed in accordance with brand's Standard Operating Procedures.


**Managing Benefits Education and Administration**


* Manages Workers Compensation claims to ensure appropriate employee care and costs management.


* Educates employees on benefits package.


* Educates HR team on the various types of benefits available and eligibility requirements.


* Provides an overview of employee benefits to the management team enabling them to educate their employees and answer routine questions.


* Ensures that department has the available resources on hand to administer employee benefits.


**Managing and Conducting Staff Development Activities**


* Ensures hourly performance appraisal processes are in place.


* Assists in identifying key drivers of employee satisfaction and supports managers in addressing issues with written plans and actions.


* Coaches managers on progressive discipline process.


* Ensures development plans are in place (e.g., goals documented, progress towards goal achievement is measured).


**Managing Employee Relations and Human Resources Communication**


* Utilizes an “open door” policy to address employee problems or concerns in a timely manner.


* Ensures effective employee communication channels are established and active in.


* Analyzes accident trends and reports these trends to the management team.


* Monitors work environment for signs of union organization.

  


*At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity. We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated. Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates. We are committed to non\-discrimination on any protected basis, including disability, veteran status, or other basis protected by applicable law.*
At more than 100 award\-winning properties worldwide, The Ritz\-Carlton Ladies and Gentlemen create experiences so exceptional that long after a guest stays with us, the experience stays with them. Attracting the world’s top hospitality professionals who curate lifelong memories, we believe that everyone succeeds when they are empowered to be creative, thoughtful and compassionate.  




  

Every day, we set the standard for rare and special luxury service the world over and pride ourselves on delivering excellence in the care and comfort of our guests.
  

Your role will be to ensure that the “Gold Standards” of The Ritz\-Carlton are delivered graciously and thoughtfully every day. The Gold Standards are the foundation of The Ritz\-Carlton and are what guides us each day to be better than the next. It is this foundation and our belief that our culture drives success by which The Ritz Carlton has earned the reputation as a global brand leader in luxury hospitality. As part of our team, you will learn and exemplify the Gold Standards, such as our Employee Promise, Credo and our Service Values. And our promise to you is that we offer the chance to be proud of the work you do and who you work with.
  

In joining The Ritz\-Carlton, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. **Be** where you can do your best work, **begin** your purpose, **belong** to an amazing global team, and **become** the best version of you.

title: HR and Admin Assistant Manager
description:
**Associate — HR, Admin \& Client Success** Telosa · Baner, Pune · On\-site, 5 days/week · Full\-time · 1\+ year experience Reports to: Founder \& CEO

**About Telosa**

Telosa is an AI\-powered customer experience platform for multi\-location brands — reputation, listings, lead capture, AI resolution and marketing in one dashboard. We work with enterprise clients across India, MENA and Southeast Asia. Small team, fast decisions, direct exposure to how a company gets built.

**The role**

This is the founder's support role for everything that keeps the company running — people, office, compliance — plus the coordination behind client renewals and the quality of what leaves Telosa in writing. It suits someone early in their career who is organised, versatile, and wants range rather than a narrow lane. You will learn by sitting close to the founder and being the person things route through.

**What you'll do**

*Human Resources*

* Coordinate hiring: post roles, source through portals and consultants, do first\-level screening calls, schedule interviews, and follow up with candidates through offer and joining.
* Run onboarding — documentation, appointment letters, induction, asset handover, first\-week experience — and handle exits with the same care.
* Maintain employee records, attendance and leave data; prepare the monthly payroll input for the founder's review.
* Keep HR policy documents current and be the first point of contact for everyday employee queries.
* Organise team events, the festival and birthday calendar, and review scheduling.

*Administration \& Office*

* Run the Baner office day to day: facilities, housekeeping, IT assets, supplies, vendor coordination and AMC renewals.
* Track statutory and compliance paperwork, registrations, insurance and licence renewals; coordinate with the CA and external consultants.
* Process invoices, reimbursements and petty cash; support finance on collections follow\-up.
* Arrange travel, accommodation and visa paperwork for the team.

*Client Renewals — coordination*

* Maintain the master contract tracker: every client, value, renewal date and notice period, always current.
* Flag renewals 60–90 days ahead and pull together the account's usage and outcome data with the customer success and product teams, so the founder walks in prepared.
* Push renewal documentation through to signature and track receivables against it.
* Raise early warning signs — client gone quiet, delayed payment, dropped usage.

*External Communications*

* Draft and manage correspondence going out under the founder's name: client and partner follow\-ups, meeting notes, action trackers, investor update inputs.
* Manage the founder's calendar and prepare briefing notes ahead of external meetings.
* Own the shared inboxes and coordinate outbound comms with the marketing team.
* Keep decks, proposals and templates versioned and presentable.

**What we're looking for**

* 1\+ year of experience in HR, executive assistance, business operations, client servicing or a similar coordination role. Strong internship experience counts.
* High ownership. Chases things to closure without reminders, keeps confidences, and holds several unrelated threads in a day without dropping any.
* Genuinely strong written English. You will be drafting on behalf of the founder; the writing has to land without correction.
* Graduate in any discipline; an MBA/PGDM in HR is welcome but not required.
* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets, PowerPoint and business email, and quick to pick up new tools.
* Presentable and composed with senior external stakeholders — clients, investors, partners, vendors.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to payroll, statutory compliance or contract administration.
* Experience in a B2B SaaS, startup or agency environment.

**What you get**

* A direct line to the founder and visibility into every part of the business — hiring, clients, fundraising, operations. Rare at this stage of a career.
* Real ownership from month one, not a filing job.
* Compensation as per experience.
* Baner, Pune. On\-site, Monday to Friday.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Director, Technical Business Consulting
description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Senior Director, Global Delivery Hub – Pune, India**
======================================================

Zendesk  



  

**Position Overview**
---------------------

Zendesk is seeking an experienced Senior Director to lead and develop the Global Delivery Hub based in Pune, India. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for driving the vision, execution, and growth of our consulting and staffing business operations in India. You will oversee end\-to\-end delivery excellence, manage key client relationships, lead a diverse team of talented professionals, and ensure our India operations support global business objectives while maintaining the highest standards of service delivery and client satisfaction.


This is an excellent opportunity to make a significant impact on Zendesk's global services strategy, shape the future of our delivery capabilities, and build and mentor a world\-class organization.  



  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Strategic Vision \& Business Leadership**

 Develop and execute the strategic vision and roadmap for the Zendesk Global Delivery Hub in India, aligned with overall business goals and growth initiatives


 Lead the entire India AI consulting, data migration and custom development teams, driving customer adoption, growth and operational excellence


 Partner with Global Services leadership team on strategic planning and execution to support global business requirements through India\-based delivery capabilities


 Enable cross\-region coordination between global clients and India delivery teams to ensure seamless service delivery  



  

### **Client \& Stakeholder Management**

 Manage key client relationships and serve as the primary executive stakeholder for major accounts


 Oversee multiple project delivery teams to ensure client satisfaction for customer engagements


 Drive client satisfaction, retention, and account growth initiatives


 Maintain focus on understanding client needs and driving continuous improvements in service delivery  



  

### **Delivery Operations \& Quality**

 Oversee end\-to\-end consulting and staffing delivery operations


 Ensure delivery quality, productivity, and fulfillment metrics meet or exceed established targets


 Establish effective governance structures, processes, and performance metrics to ensure efficient, cost\-effective operations aligned with global customer priorities


 Identify and implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance capabilities, productivity, and service delivery  



  

### **Organizational Leadership \& Development**

 Lead and develop the Global delivery organization in India, including recruiting, delivery, and operations teams


 Oversee hiring, performance management, KPIs, and organizational planning


 Build engaged, productive teams that collaborate effectively across roles, departments, locations, and external partners


 Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and employee development


 Energize and inspire people through empowerment, recognition, and passion  



  

### **Operational Excellence \& Scalability**

 Develop and optimize operational processes to enable scalability and growth


 Collaborate with Finance, HR, Compliance, Recruiting, and Operations to drive organizational effectiveness


 Mitigate risk and solve complex problems through innovative and out\-of\-the\-box thinking


 Manage continuity, change, and transition effectively in a dynamic environment  



  

### **Leadership \& Culture**

 Embody and model Zendesk values, mission, and vision


 Demonstrate integrity, develop people, and build high\-performing teams


 Drive organizational change and influence others toward shared goals


 Address the impact of attitude and action on the organization and its participants  



  

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**
-----------------------------------------

 15\+ years of progressive leadership experience in consulting, services delivery, staffing, or professional services organizations


 10\+ years of senior leadership experience managing P\&L, large teams, and complex operations at a regional or global scale


 Proven track record of building and scaling high\-performing organizations from the ground up


 Demonstrated success driving revenue growth, profitability, and operational efficiency


 Experience managing key strategic client relationships and driving client satisfaction and retention


 Experience operating successfully in matrix organization structures


 Strong background in recruiting, talent development, and performance management


 Experience implementing operational improvements and continuous optimization initiatives


 Knowledge of India market dynamics and experience operating India\-based delivery centers highly preferred


 Experience in AI, technology services, or customer\-centric delivery models preferred


 Bachelor's degree required; MBA or equivalent advanced business qualification preferred  



  

**Core Competencies**
---------------------

  

### **Customer Focus**

Strives for customer success and exceeds expectations by understanding client needs and driving meaningful improvements in products and services. Takes a proactive approach to identifying opportunities to enhance the customer experience.  



  

### **Team Collaboration**

Builds engaged, productive teams while sharing knowledge and collaborating effectively across roles, departments, and locations. Extends collaboration externally with partners and customers. Creates an environment where diverse perspectives are valued and leveraged.  



  

### **Motivation \& Engagement**

Energizes and inspires teams through empowerment, recognition, and genuine passion for excellence. Manages continuity, change, and transition with grace. Skillfully influences and enables others to achieve shared objectives. Understands the impact of attitude and action on organizational success.  



  

### **Leading Change**

Possesses the skills and implements the functions of a transformational leader. Shares and communicates the company's values, mission, and vision effectively. Consistently displays integrity, models desired behaviors, develops talent, and builds strong, cohesive teams. Navigates organizational change while maintaining team morale and performance.  



  

### **Innovation \& Problem\-Solving**

Mitigates risk and solves complex problems through innovative, out\-of\-the\-box thinking and creative problem\-solving approaches. Challenges conventional wisdom and drives continuous improvement.  



  

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

We are seeking a strategic, visionary leader with an entrepreneurial mindset who can build and scale an exceptional delivery organization in India. The ideal candidate will:


 Have a genuine passion for building world\-class organizations and developing talent


 Demonstrate a customer\-first mentality and commitment to exceeding client expectations


 Bring strategic thinking with strong execution capabilities


 Show comfort operating in ambiguity and driving results in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment


 Possess strong financial acumen and business judgment


 Display emotional intelligence and the ability to inspire diverse teams


 Be a strong communicator with excellent presentation skills for executive\-level audiences


 Have experience navigating complex organizational structures and stakeholder dynamics  



  

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.


Hybrid: In this role, our hybrid experience is designed at the team level to give you a rich onsite experience packed with connection, collaboration, learning, and celebration \- while also giving you flexibility to work remotely for part of the week. This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in\-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.


**The intelligent heart of customer experience**

Zendesk software was built to bring a sense of calm to the chaotic world of customer service. Today we power billions of conversations with brands you know and love.


Zendesk believes in offering our people a fulfilling and inclusive experience. Our hybrid way of working, enables us to purposefully come together in person, at one of our many Zendesk offices around the world, to connect, collaborate and learn whilst also giving our people the flexibility to work remotely for part of the week.


As part of our commitment to fairness and transparency, we inform all applicants that artificial intelligence (AI) or automated decision systems may be used to screen or evaluate applications for this position, in accordance with Company guidelines and applicable law.

title: Director of Customer Experience, Sell
description:
**Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)**  

**Permanent \- Full Time**

  

**About Us:**  

  

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.  

  

  

  

**About The Role:**

The Sell Director is one of the most senior leaders in the Customer Experience organisation, accountable for the full performance of the Sell domain and for outcomes that roll up to the overall CX organisation: CSAT, SLA performance and Cost of Support.


This role owns the operating model, people decisions, quality standards, KPI performance and transformation agenda for the Sell domain. A core part of the role is leading the domain Subject Matter Experts, who preserve tacit product knowledge and turn it into practical training, documented knowledge and AI\-ready content used by internal teams, the BPO, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis and AI\-enabled support.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own CSAT, SLA and Cost of Support outcomes for the Sell domain, with clear reporting to CX Leadership.
* Own the operational KPIs that drive those outcomes: First Reply, Next Reply, First Contact Resolution, Reopen Rate and Abandoned Call performance.
* Own hiring, promotion, performance management and termination decisions across the domain, within company and HR policy.
* Ensure support quality is maintained through clear standards, coaching, knowledge use, escalation handling and customer communication.
* Lead the domain SMEs as a strategic knowledge capability: capture tacit product knowledge, convert it into training, documented guidance and AI\-usable content, and keep that knowledge current.
* Use SME insight to spot product knowledge gaps, support process issues, training needs and AI answer\-quality gaps, then drive fixes with Quality \& Training and Systems \& Analysis.
* Drive AI adoption, automation and self\-service that reduce unnecessary human touch and Cost of Support while maintaining or improving customer outcomes.
* Run the domain operating rhythm across performance review, KPI analysis, risk/action tracking, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Partner with BPO Management, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis, Product, Engineering and Commercial teams to remove blockers and improve execution.
* Provide concise, evidence\-based updates to the SVP of CX and CX Leadership, including risks, root causes, corrective actions and progress against commitments.

**SME, Knowledge and AI Accountability**

The Director is accountable for making SME knowledge operational: not only answering difficult questions, but improving the whole support model by raising capability, reducing repeat issues and making knowledge reusable across teams and AI.


* Prioritise SME work based on customer impact, ticket demand, product complexity, BPO readiness and AI adoption opportunities.
* Ensure SME outputs flow into training, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, QA calibration, macros, escalation logic and AI knowledge sources.
Create a simple governance rhythm for SME output, including knowledge gaps, training needs, AI content improvements and measurable impact on CSAT, SLA, FCR, reopens and cost. This may look like following the KCS standard, or other such framework.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Extensive leadership experience in customer experience, customer support, contact\-centre operations or comparable service delivery environments.
* Equivalent experience is valued where the individual has demonstrated ownership of large\-scale operational outcomes, multi\-level teams, financial performance, customer experience quality and specialist knowledge\-management capability.
* Proven ownership of CSAT, SLA, Cost of Support and related operational KPIs in a complex support environment.
* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.
* Executive\-level communication skills, with concise reporting of performance, risk, decisions and corrective actions.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience leading a product\-aligned support domain similar in scale or complexity to Sell.
* Experience in a global, matrixed CX organisation with centralised quality, systems, analytics, SME and BPO support functions.
Experience with Zendesk, CCaaS, workforce management, knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled support tooling or major cost\-to\-serve transformation.  
* 

  

**Working For Us:**  

  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. title: Director of Customer Experience, Design
description:
**Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)**  

**Permanent \- Full Time**

  

**About Us:**  

  

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

**About The Role:**

The Design Director is one of the most senior leaders in the Customer Experience organisation, accountable for the full performance of the Design domain and for outcomes that roll up to the overall CX organisation: CSAT, SLA performance and Cost of Support.


This role owns the operating model, people decisions, quality standards, KPI performance and transformation agenda for the Design domain. A core part of the role is leading the domain Subject Matter Experts, who preserve tacit product knowledge and turn it into practical training, documented knowledge and AI\-ready content used by internal teams, the BPO, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis and AI\-enabled support.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own CSAT, SLA and Cost of Support outcomes for the Design domain, with clear reporting to CX Leadership.

* Lead the domain SMEs as a strategic knowledge capability: capture tacit product knowledge, convert it into training, documented guidance and AI\-usable content, and keep that knowledge current.
* Use SME insight to spot product knowledge gaps, support process issues, training needs and AI answer\-quality gaps, then drive fixes with Quality \& Training and Systems \& Analysis.
* Drive AI adoption, automation and self\-service that reduce unnecessary human touch and Cost of Support while maintaining or improving customer outcomes.
* Run the domain operating rhythm across performance review, KPI analysis, risk/action tracking, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Partner with BPO Management, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis, Product, Engineering and Commercial teams to remove blockers and improve execution.
* Provide concise, evidence\-based updates to the SVP of CX and CX Leadership, including risks, root causes, corrective actions and progress against commitments.

**SME, Knowledge and AI Accountability**

The Director is accountable for making SME knowledge operational: not only answering difficult questions, but improving the whole support model by raising capability, reducing repeat issues and making knowledge reusable across teams and AI.

* Proven ownership of CSAT, SLA, Cost of Support and related operational KPIs in a complex support environment.
* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.
* Executive\-level communication skills, with concise reporting of performance, risk, decisions and corrective actions.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience leading a product\-aligned support domain similar in scale or complexity to Design.
* Experience in a global, matrixed CX organisation with centralised quality, systems, analytics, SME and BPO support functions.
Experience with Zendesk, CCaaS, workforce management, knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled support tooling or major cost\-to\-serve transformation.

**Our Application Process**
---------------------------


We’re constantly looking for talented individuals who are ready to be part of our dynamic and growing organization. Ferrero is a company with a global presence and family values. Join us!

##### **1\. Apply**


Complete your online application, upload your CV and include brief cover letter to help us understand your experience and interests

##### **2\. Assess**


Our HR team will arrange a phone or video interview if we feel your qualifications are a good match for the job

##### **3\. Interview**


If the first interview goes well, you’ll be invited to speak with a Ferrero manager to assess your competencies, technical aptitude and fit within our dynamic organization
